notes.title: Alchemist Hut Released!
notes.content:
After a few weeks of hard work, we are coming back with the latest update!

- New World Added - Alchemist Hut!
- 35 new levels
- New challenging mechanics

Match the potions, break books and scrolls and smash the crystals.
Solve, Explore, and Conquer the Alchemist Hut!
